newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Glorious Sun to issue 250 mln shrs at HK$1.60 each.
newsitem.headline: Glorious Sun to issue 250 mln shrs at HK$1.60 each.

text.p: Jeans and casual wear maker Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to issue 250 million new shares, or 25 percent of its expanded share capital, at HK$1.60 per share to raise a total HK$400 million.
The offer comprises a public offer of 100 million new shares and a placing of 150 million new shares both at the offer price, the company said.

If the number of shares applied for in the public offer represented three times or more of the number of shares available for subscription, a total of 25 million shares will be reallocated from the placing to the new issue, it said.
Public subscription will be started from September 5 to 10 and dealing in shares is expected to begin on September 17.
Glorious Sun forecast the combined profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items for the year ended March 31, 1997 will not be less than HK$168 million.
Profit attributed to shareholder for 1995/96 was HK$91.64 million and 1994/95 was 33.71 million.
The company had a distributon network of 203 outlets in China and 146 in Australia.
Net proceed of about HK$375 million will be used to develop and expand its retail network in China, Australia and New Zealand, it said.
HSBC Investment bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinater, sponsor and lead mannager of the offering.
